QuestInfo.name: Open Advancement: Jobs and You
QuestInfo.0: Now that you have reached your 4th job advancement,  #p9010000# wants to speak with you.
QuestInfo.1: What is the Open Advancement? Something Explorers can do after the 4th Job Advancement?
QuestInfo.2: You can take a new job! What kind of adventures await?

0.0: Did you know that Explorers can now take what we call an #bOpen Advancement#k? It's great for somebody looking to try something new. I'll tell you more, if you're interested.

yes.0: When you get to your #b4th job as an Explorer, and are over level 101#k, you can switch to #banother job in your class#k. For example, if you are a Hero right now, you can become Paladin or Dark Knight.
yes.1: You can get a Job Advancement by going to the #b4th Job Instructor#k for your job in the #bForest of the Priest#k, just past #bLeafre's Valley of the Antelope#k. You will also need #bOpen Advancement Coin#k. You can also #bpay Mesos#k, if you don't have enough coins.
yes.2: Remember, the higher your level is, or the higher the number of Open Advancements you take is, the #rhigher the price you will pay#k.

no.0: You must be satisfied with your current job. Enjoy your Mapling!
